apps.localizedDescription:
# uYouEnhanced v21.14.4-3.0.5

> **Note:** `uYou 3.0.5` in this release is an **Unofficial Update**, a patched build of MiRO92's uYou 3.0.4 with modern-uYou fixes applied on top. It is not an official release by MiRO92.

## DIY (Build uYouEnhanced Yourself) 🛠️
This decision was made because uYouEnhanced and other similar tweaks have been subject to DMCA takedowns by Google. As a result, IPA files cannot be publicly released or hosted on this platform. Please read the [Wiki - Building](https://github.com/arichornlover/uYouEnhanced/wiki/Building) guide.

## What's Big in 21.14.4-3.0.5 🚀

**uYou Downloads Rebuilt for Modern YouTube** | A brand-new download pipeline fetches streams directly through YouTube's innertube API (iOS client context), replacing uYou 3.0.4's broken extraction that caused infinite "(null) | Downloading..." states. WebM→M4A audio conversion (partial), metadata handling (partial), and merge fallbacks are retained and hardened.

**App Icons That Actually Work** | Alternate icons are now properly registered into the app at build time and applied through Apple's native API. The picker was redesigned into a fresh grid looking interface, should be also fully adaptive from iPhone up to iPad in any orientation (hopefully).

**Notifications Tab is now Reorderable** The restored Notifications tab added in previous releases can now be positioned (1st–5th or End) from uYouEnhanced settings, done this even without conflicting uYou's own Reorder Tabs feature surpisingly.

**Stability Hardening** iSponsorBlock integration is now build-optional (off by default) after being identified as the source that crashed uYouEnhanced on startup. (it's recommended to leave it off for now)

**iPad & Landscape Color Picker Fix** Color pickers present as proper form sheets (no more broken scaling, which was a mistake on my part), and all custom interfaces adapt correctly across iPhone/iPad in both orientations.


**Developer Tooling** added a lot of Python scripts (`Scripts/`) for symbols, selector auditing, and binary inspection, without needing to use a mac, without this, the v21.14.4-3.0.5 release would've taken longer to release.

## uYouEnhanced Features

- **Notifications Tab** | Restores the pre-2020 Pivot Bar Notifications tab with customization options, now with position control.
- **BackUp & Restore PLUS Settings** | Copy/paste your tweak settings via clipboard or file, including tweak-compatible extras beyond uYouPlus.
- **YouTimeStamp** | Copy the video URL with the exact timestamp for easy sharing.
- **Low Contrast Mode** | Dims labels and icons for a less bright interface (specific app versions only).
- **Fake YouTube Premium** | Premium-style logo and buttons for a premium appearance.
- **No Heatwaves** | Removes the heatwave effect in the video player.
- **No Upgrade Dialog** | Disables YouTube's update prompts.
- **App Settings Overlay Options** | Hide sections like Account, Autoplay, and more.
- **App Version Spoofer** | Spoof the app version number when needed.
- **uYou UNOFFICIAL 3.0.5 update** | All original uYou download features (video/audio downloads, conversion, metadata) now powered by the new pipeline I've made for this release of uYouEnhanced.

## Release Information

Current YouTube Version: `v21.14.4`
Current uYou Version: `v3.0.5` *(Unofficial Update of 3.0.4)*
Current App Compatibility: `iOS/iPadOS 16.0` or later.

**RELEASE:** August 22, 2026

- YouTube base updated to `v21.14.4`
- uYou rebranded to `3.0.5 (Unofficial)` with download fixes baked in
- Fixed: startup crash on 21.x (iSponsorBlock selector conflict) - code is disabled because iSponsorBlock is not natively in uYouEnhanced now.
- Fixed: infinite "Downloading..." / `(null)` progress states (uYou)
- Fixed: App Icon changer (registration + new grid UI)
- Added: Notifications Tab position control in uYouEnhanced Setting
- Added: floating quick-action bar in Root Options Controller.
- Added: CI crash-analysis tooling (Scripts folder)
- Removed: hooks targeting classes deleted from modern YouTube (YouTubeHeader)

## What's Changed
* Add FAQ section to README by @ashrees in https://github.com/arichornlover/uYouEnhanced/pull/985

## New Contributors
* @ashrees made their first contribution in https://github.com/arichornlover/uYouEnhanced/pull/985

**Full Changelog because I know I didn't list every change, this release of uYouEnhanced is TOO BIG**: https://github.com/arichornlover/uYouEnhanced/compare/v20.44.2-3.0.4...v21.14.4-3.0.5

apps.localizedDescription:
### Latest Stable Release, ENJOY!!
##### Cracked by [zarzelworkshop](https://t.me/zarzelworkshop)

> [!NOTE]
> - no subscription required
> - ✅ Working Download Manager, switch to overlay button before downloading.
> - Bundled with **YTUHD**. it is broken in +21.25.5 versions as of now. max resolution is 1080p60. devices with native AV1 can still see 4K.
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YTUHD` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks`
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino`  `VolumeBoostYT` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`

> [!WARNING]
> - Versions **+21.25.5 and newer** are **not recommended** right now.  
> - Extra tweaks that are bundled with main tweak are currently unstable on newer versions.".
